items.source: For server scenarios this class can be declared as a bean in Spring configuration and that would detect @MessageMapping methods in @Controller beans. What beans are checked can be changed through a handlerPredicate. Given an instance of this class, you can then use responder() to obtain a SocketAcceptor adapter to register with the RSocketServer.
items.translation: 对于服务器场景，此类可以在 Spring 配置中声明为 bean，从而检测 `@Controller` bean 中的`@MessageMapping` 方法。可以通过handlerPredicate来检查哪些 bean。给定此类的实例，您可以使用responder()获取一个`SocketAcceptor`适配器，并将其注册到`RSocketServer`中。

items.source: For a client, possibly in the same process as a server, consider using the static factory method responder(RSocketStrategies, Object...) to obtain a client responder to be registered via RSocketRequester.Builder.
items.translation: 对于客户端（可能位于与服务器相同的进程中），请考虑使用静态工厂方法 responder(RSocketStrategies, Object...) 获取客户端响应器，并通过 RSocketRequester.Builder 进行注册。

items.source: The initial ConnectionSetupPayload is handled through @ConnectionMapping methods that can be asynchronous and return Mono<Void> with an error signal preventing the connection. Such a method can also start requests to the client but that must be done decoupled from handling and from the current thread.
items.translation: 初始的 `ConnectionSetupPayload` 通过 `@ConnectionMapping` 方法进行处理，这些方法可以是异步的并返回 `Mono<Void>`，同时包含一个错误信号以阻止连接。此类方法还可以向客户端发起请求，但必须与处理逻辑及当前线程解耦。

items.source: Subsequent requests on the connection can be handled with MessageMapping and RSocketExchange methods.
items.translation: 连接上的后续请求可以使用 `MessageMapping` 和 `RSocketExchange` 方法进行处理。

items.source: For @MessageMapping and @RSocketExchange methods, this class automatically determines the RSocket interaction type based on the input and output cardinality of the method. See the "Annotated Responders" section of the Spring Framework reference for more details.
items.translation: 对于 `@MessageMapping` 和 `@RSocketExchange` 方法，该类会根据方法的输入和输出基数自动确定 RSocket 交互类型。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 Spring Framework 参考中的 “注解响应器” 部分。

items.source: Note that the given handlers do not need to have any stereotype annotations such as @Controller which helps to avoid overlap with server side handlers that may be used in the same application. However, for more advanced scenarios, for example, discovering handlers through a custom stereotype annotation, consider declaring RSocketMessageHandler as a bean, and then obtain the responder from it.
items.translation: 请注意，给定的处理器不需要具有任何立体注解（例如 `@Controller`），这有助于避免与同一应用程序中可能使用的服务器端处理器发生重叠。然而，对于更高级的场景，例如通过自定义立体注解发现处理器，请考虑将 `RSocketMessageHandler` 声明为 Bean，然后从中获取响应器。
